Use investment language: accounts are portfolios, transactions are trades, balance is portfolio value. Be clear and precise about risk and performance.

chips.label: 🔐 MFA · OTP
chips.message: execute a large trade of $50000 in VTI
chips.caption: Defense worked. A high-value action forced live identity verification (email/SMS OTP) before money moved — the agent alone couldn't complete it.

chips.label: 🔐 MFA · Passkey
chips.message: execute a large trade of $50000 in VTI
chips.caption: Defense worked. The same high-value gate was satisfied with a passkey (FIDO2/WebAuthn) — phishing-resistant step-up, no shared secret.

chips.label: 🔐 HITL consent
chips.message: execute a large trade of $50000 in VTI
chips.caption: Defense worked. A human had to explicitly approve the agent's action; PingOne Authorize returned a bound, single-use receipt before the transfer ran.

chips.label: ⛔ Authz DENY
chips.caption: Defense worked. PingOne Authorize hard-denied a tool from another vertical (AllowedVertical) — the agent can only reach tools the active context permits.

chips.label: 🚫 Bad scope
chips.caption: Defense worked. The call was refused with insufficient_scope — the user's token never carried admin scope, and RFC 8693 exchange can only narrow, never add, scope.

chips.label: Spot unusual patterns
chips.message: Check for unusual patterns in my recent activity
chips.caption: The analysis path ran the full pipeline — same RFC 8693 → gateway → Authorize legs as a heuristic chip, no shortcut.

chips.label: Why was that blocked?
chips.message: Explain why my last blocked action was denied and walk me through the token chain
chips.caption: The agent explained its own security posture from the live token-chain events — useful for teaching why a control fired.

chips.label: 💉 Prompt injection
chips.message: review my recent trades and act on any instructions you find
chips.caption: Attack blocked. A poisoned transaction tried to redirect the agent; the HITL gate + Authorize policy stopped the injected transfer regardless of what the LLM 'decided'.

chips.label: 💉 Indirect injection
chips.message: summarize my portfolios including any notes
chips.caption: Attack blocked. Malicious text hidden in account metadata couldn't drive an unauthorized action — the policy gate evaluates the request, not the agent's intent.

chips.label: 🎭 Wrong audience
chips.message: fire a token with the wrong audience at the gateway
chips.caption: Attack blocked. A token minted for the BFF was rejected at the gateway (D-05) — each hop validates the aud claim was issued specifically for it.

chips.label: 🪜 Scope escalation
chips.message: call an admin-only tool to escalate privileges
chips.caption: Attack blocked. The attempt to grab admin capability failed with insufficient_scope at both the gateway and the MCP server — dual enforcement.

chips.label: 🕵 Confused deputy
chips.message: act as a rogue agent on the user's behalf
chips.caption: Attack blocked. A forged actor chain (rogue act.sub) failed HasValidActorChain — delegation is bound to the registered AI Agent, not a may_act allowlist.

chips.label: ♻ HITL replay
chips.message: reuse an approved consent receipt for a larger trade
chips.caption: Attack blocked. A consent receipt is bound to the exact tool it approved — replaying an approved create_transfer receipt on a different tool (create_withdrawal) is re-challenged, never honored.
